name: ZMM_INTER_ASSOCIATIONS
description: Any communication related to business object is captured by this entity (for example, a Service Request, an Opportunity); This table holds all business object information associated with the interaction. In addition it does business activity tracking of the business objects (i.e. any action create, update).

columns.name: INTERACTION_ASSOCIATION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the Interaction Associations Table.

columns.name: INTER_ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: It describes the interaction type created for either Task or Appointment.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: This references the interaction that the corresponding associated object belongs to. All Business objects corresponding to Interaction is identified by this attribute.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_OBJECT_UID
columns.description: ID of the ZMM Object, from the Objects Metadata. It will hold consuming product table’s information, and corresponding ObjectId is retireved using Objects Metadata

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: ID of the ZMM Object Type, from the Objects Metadata.It will hold consuming product table’s information, and corresponding Object Type is retireved using Objects Metadata

columns.name: ASSOCIATION_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Sequence of business objects for an interaction. Sequence can be like Create an order, update a service request, and create an opportunity. All the above-mentioned will generate a sequence.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Tracks kind of action performed on the Business object. Like created, updated, viewed, re-opened, closed etc. Value is Obtained through lookup

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
